No priestly call to midnight watch,

Or rite which Heaven had blest.

Far other than we fondly think,

The ways of God are found ;

He speaks within the heart, and we

We go to friends for friendly aid,

We wander far abroad ;

Our conscience undefiled !

Be ours the true obedience,

Which loves, and loving, fears ;

Safe for the city with gateways of pearls ;

Safe for the province where foe may not dare.
